summary: Tanjong Marine Services Pte Ltd faces payment rejection risks due to the use of an outdated intermediary bank and incorrect BIC codes for Nordkyst Bank.

warnings.title: Use of Outdated Intermediary Bank
warnings.detail: Tanjong Marine Services has repeatedly used Atlantic Clearing Bank for USD payments to Nordkyst Bank, which has switched its correspondent to Hudson Federal Bank as of September 1, 2026.
warnings.fix: Update payment instructions to route via Hudson Federal Bank instead of Atlantic Clearing Bank.

warnings.title: BIC / Routing Detail Errors
warnings.detail: Past payments have been rejected due to incorrect BIC codes for Nordkyst Bank, such as using NKYSNOBX instead of NKYSNOBB.
warnings.fix: Verify that the correct BIC for Nordkyst Bank (NKYSNOBB) is used before submission.

evidence.text: Tanjong Marine Services Pte Ltd attempted to send USD 27,610.00 to Bergen Subsea Services AS at Nordkyst Bank on 2026-09-18, but the payment was rejected with code RC01 because it used the obsolete intermediary Atlantic Clearing Bank instead of the new correspondent, Hudson Federal Bank.

Tanjong Marine Services Pte Ltd attempted to send USD 41,000.00 to Bergen Subsea Services AS on 2026-09-02, but the payment was rejected with code RC01 because it used the outdated intermediary Atlantic Clearing Bank instead of the new correspondent, Hudson Federal Bank.

Tanjong Marine Services Pte Ltd attempted to send USD 28,640.00 to Stavanger Offshore Supply AS at Nordkyst Bank on 2026-09-08, but the payment was rejected with code RC01 because it used the outdated intermediary Atlantic Clearing Bank instead of the new correspondent, Hudson Federal Bank.

Tanjong Marine Services Pte Ltd attempted to send USD 23,580.00 to Bergen Subsea Services AS at Nordkyst Bank on 2026-08-25, but the payment was rejected with code RC01 due to an incorrect BIC (NKYSNOBX instead of NKYSNOBB).
Nordkyst Bank (NKYS) changed its USD correspondent bank from Atlantic Clearing Bank (ACBKUS33) to Hudson Federal Bank (HFBKUS33), effective September 1, 2026.

directives.name: Sanctions holds are human-only
directives.content: Never recommend releasing, auto-approving or bypassing a payment held by sanctions screening, even if the beneficiary was cleared before. Always route sanctions hits to the Compliance team for human review; a prior clearance reference may be cited only as supporting context.

directives.name: Mask account numbers
directives.content: Never write a full bank account number or IBAN in an answer. Show only the last 4 characters, e.g. ****0913.

directives.name: Cite evidence
directives.content: When you state a pattern, cite the dates or case IDs of the past exceptions it is based on. If memory has no relevant evidence, say so explicitly instead of guessing.
